# A soluble variety not generated by its finite groups

There is a variety of groups of bounded derived length that is not generated by its finite groups: some law holds in all of its finite groups but fails in one of its groups.

Source: E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 21st issue, arXiv:1401.0300v49 (2026), Archive of Solved Problems, Problem 5.43 (A. Yu. Olshanskii); resolution: Yu. G. Kleiman, Trans. Moscow Math. Soc. 1983, no. 2, 63-110.
